0022600192.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder host the Washington Wizards in their 10th game of the season, with the Thunder at 7-2, unbeaten at home at 4-0, on a three-game winning streak, and first in the Northwest Division. Washington is 4-5, has lost two straight, and sits 8th in the East, 1.5 games behind for second in the Southeast, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 132-111 win in Washington on March 21. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Jaylin Williams (back, spasms), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Washington is without Anthony Davis (ankle, sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve).
